setting: Contemporary, modern Western society shaped by smartphone culture, suburban/urban workplace life and weekly church community involvement; everyday pressures of career, family relationships, and digital distraction.
spiritual_theme: A movement from compartmentalized, private faith and distracted religiosity toward integrated, surrendered daily devotion—reordering priorities so faith governs ordinary life rather than being confined to Sundays.
emotional_palette: Starts with quiet complacency and distracted routine, shifts to unease and conviction after a pastoral prompt, deepens into guilt and restlessness (sleeplessness, strained relationships), moves into decisive resolve and small courageous actions (calling her sister, placing the Bible by the bed), and resolves into relief, renewed connection, steady peace and joyful habit-forming persistence.
